risks.proof: Video of the camera powering on, taking a photo, and reviewing the image on the LCD.

risks.risk: Lens has fungus, haze, separation, or autofocus failure
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements plus a video of autofocus hunting.
risks.if_unproven: as a faulty or manual-focus-only lens

risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from the camera menu or via software.

risks.risk: Missing battery, charger, strap, or box

proof_requests: Video of the camera turning on, firing the shutter, and reviewing a photo.
Close-up photos of the lens front and rear glass for fungus or haze.
Screenshot of the shutter count from the camera menu.
Photo of any included battery, charger, box, and strap.
response.reason: The camera and lens are clearly identifiable from the photos, so a worst-case price can be set for a non-working body with unproven optics; functionality proof would raise the value.
